measured_quantities_and_default_features.feed_fraction: mol H2 per mol feed, fraction
measured_quantities_and_default_features.normal_flow_L_min: normal L min^-1; assumed 22.414 L mol^-1
measured_quantities_and_default_features.calibration_j0: mol H2 m^-2 s^-1; frozen pure-hydrogen calibration
measured_quantities_and_default_features.membrane_index: dimensionless index of declared calibrated membrane

information_budget.observation_window: Known membrane, inert gas, temperature, feed fraction, absolute pressures, normal feed flow and specimen geometry only; no mixture flux or held-out pure-hydrogen response. Expanded information budget: temperature_K, feed_fraction, normal_flow_L_min, retentate_bar, permeate_bar, area_m2, calibration_j0, membrane, gas, membrane_index, length_m, diameter_m
information_budget.calibration_and_history: See frozen development protocol and per-fold states; all learned calibration is training-partition-only. All models have the declared 64 pure-hydrogen measurements at 350/450 C through frozen pressure/permeance calibration. No 400 C calibration was available during fitting. Normal molar volume 22.414 L/mol is a stated convention.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
scope_ambiguities: Historical training membership is missing for 84 model/fold records; replay cannot recover it.
